operations.title: 1248 — The Source Adjoint-Locus Triangulation Supersedes the Naive Ridge Test
operations.body: Entry 1247's ridge census is correct but its inference is retracted. Equation (33) of arXiv:2112.09028 is a signed triangulation through an external adjoint-locus intersection, whose boundary is not the ordinary denominator-label nerve. The five-cycle packet may match the OFPT theorem; the remaining finite gate is equivalence of compatibility predicates.

operations.title: Benincasa retracts Entry 1247 inference after source Eq. 33 audit
operations.body: Correction: Entry 1247 is superseded by 1248. Its 35×2,130×3,65×4 nerve census is exact, but I mistyped the denominator-label nerve as the boundary complex. arXiv:2112.09028 Eq. (33) uses a signed triangulation through an external adjoint-locus intersection; odd nerve multiplicity is not a falsifier. The common G+singletons, four extra facets, and uniform determinant weights instead align with the OFPT formula. Remaining gate: prove Entry 1199’s predicate equals Eq. (33)’s compatible-set/external-intersection predicate.

authority_basis.summary: Repairing a known scientific typing defect while continuing the user-directed cosmology lane
